title: ZuCo 2.0: A Dataset of Physiological Recordings During Natural Reading and Annotation
answer_rationale: The document describes a normal reading paradigm as passive reading, contrasting it with task-specific reading where subjects actively search for semantic relations. This is supported by the description of eye-tracking behavior and reading times, which show that in normal reading, fixations occur until the end of the sentence, indicating passive processing.
